visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black cap and glasses stands behind a wooden table, holding a large blue dragon-like model with white wings. He points to small plastic debris (nub marks) on the table. The lighting is bright and multi-colored in the background (purple/pink). (2) Close-up shots of a black cylindrical vacuum cleaner as it sucks up colorful plastic crumbs from a grey cutting mat. The camera moves in closely to show the debris swirling inside the clear plastic container. (3) The man holds three variants of the vacuum (black, white, blue) while smiling. He demonstrates the compact size of the device relative to his hands. (4) Graphic overlays appear showing '7000pa' and '68000rpm' over a dark background with green glowing text. The scene transitions back to the vacuum cleaning a wooden surface filled with noodle-like debris. (5) A hand demonstrates a hidden nozzle feature at the bottom of the device. The vacuum is used to blow dust out of tight crevices in a computer keyboard and model kit parts. (6) The vacuum is disassembled to reveal two layers of filters: a stainless steel mesh and a white pleated HEPA 12 filter. The debris is poured out into a bin. (7) Various nozzle attachments are shown laid out on the table. The man points to the camera while holding the product, followed by a final shot of the three color variants standing upright.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Adult male wearing a black t-shirt with an 'EVANGELION' logo, a black baseball cap, and thick-rimmed glasses.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A hobbyist studio with a wooden table surface. The background features a blurred shelf with various model kits and collectibles, illuminated with purple and red ambient LED lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with upbeat, high-tempo electronic BGM featuring a driving kick drum. A male voice enters immediately with an enthusiastic, high-arousal greeting. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the shift to a product demonstration. A high-pitched, steady whirring sound of a vacuum motor dominates the mix, overlapping with the BGM. (3) The narrator continues with a fast speech rate, explaining product features. A 'ding' SFX is heard when key specifications like '7000pa' are highlighted. (4) A distinctive mechanical click and low-frequency thud occur as the user demonstrates the hidden nozzle and attachment swaps. (5) The vacuum motor sound shifts in timbre as it transitions to a blowing function, accompanied by a slight rustling noise of air hitting surfaces. (6) Percussive tapping and plastic clinking sounds are heard as the dust bin is emptied. (7) The music swells slightly in the final seconds during the call to action, ending with a clean fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem Identification -> Product Solution -> Technical Specifications -> Functional Demonstration -> Maintenance/Cleaning -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional endorsement for the ONPRO V1 Max handheld vacuum. It specifically targets the hobbyist community (model builders) by addressing the niche problem of nub marks and dust on intricate model kits. It highlights portability, suction power (7000pa), and the unique 'blow-and-suction' dual functionality to drive sales.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of the product, detailed specification breakdown, brand mentions in both audio and text overlays, and a CTA referencing a 'link in description'.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A well-produced social-native advertisement that uses hobbyist culture (Gunpla/Model building) as a vehicle for general tech marketing. The fast cuts and energetic audio are optimized for short-form video platforms.
